name: screenshot-to-code
description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
one_liner: Turns a screenshot, design mockup, or screen recording into working website code.
buyer: A freelance designer or no-code founder who has a design but no front-end developer.
business_use_cases: A designer converts a client's Figma mockup into a real working prototype without waiting on a developer.
A no-code founder turns a competitor's landing page screenshot into a starting template for their own site.
An agency speeds up prototyping by generating a first-pass build from every new mockup automatically.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'mockup to live site in 24 hours' freelance service for small businesses.
Build a niche SaaS wrapper (e.g. for real-estate listing pages) that always outputs a specific polished template.

steal_this: Offer local businesses a flat $200 'turn your napkin sketch or screenshot into a real website' service this weekend.
